sources.entry: Wallos - Lightweight personal subscription tracker with statistics and optional notifications. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Docker
Wallos | Personal subscription tracker to manage recurring expenses

summary.one_liner: Wallos is a self-hostable web app for tracking recurring subscriptions and expenses, with multi-currency support, statistics, and optional notifications.
summary.what_it_does: Wallos lets you record subscriptions and recurring payments, organize them into customizable categories, and see upcoming due dates. It supports multiple currencies and integrates with the Fixer API for exchange rates so all subscriptions can be shown in a main currency. A statistics view shows spending from different angles, and sorting and a mobile view are included. Notifications can be sent by email, Discord, Pushover, Telegram, Gotify, or webhooks. The README also mentions OIDC/OAuth login, optional AI recommendations via ChatGPT, Gemini, or local Ollama, and a documented API. It runs on bare metal with PHP and SQLite or as a Docker container.
use_cases: track recurring subscriptions and due dates
manage monthly expenses in multiple currencies
how_to_run: docker run -d --name wallos -v /path/to/config/wallos/db:/var/www/html/db -v /path/to/config/wallos/logos:/var/www/html/images/uploads/logos -e TZ=Europe/Berlin -p 8282:80 --restart unless-stopped bellamy/wallos:latest
Baremetal: move files into web root (e.g. /var/www/html)
Baremetal: open the app in a browser so migrations run on the registration page
Baremetal: add the cronjob entries from the README via crontab -e
Updating: git pull, then run php endpoints/db/migrate.php
notable: Configurable OIDC settings via OIDC_* environment variables with discovery support
SSRF allowlist can be provisioned through an environment variable
Logo search fetches subscription logos from the web if no upload is provided
AI recommendations with ChatGPT, Gemini, or local Ollama
Multi-language support with a documented translation process
caveats: Baremetal install needs PHP 8.3 with several modules plus cron jobs configured manually
Currency conversion relies on the Fixer API
